numbered_stereo.copy_policy: Derived independent name-only constitution/CIP verifier; no production naming imports or input graph. Current release adds unique rooted-component ownership, neutral three-ring N CIP, one annular E/Z bond and one uniquely numbered ol-H isotope before CIP. Multi-copy stereo assignment without complete ownership declines. The annular E/Z locant must identify the actual terminal unsaturation, on a ring of at least eight atoms.
numbered_stereo.origin: Existing authorized regression cohort predating this release; hand-authored parser controls; frozen source retained in the viability baseline. No new panel records selected.

ol_hydrogen.scope: One terminal 2H/3H ol-suffix or one hydroxy-prefix insertion; exactly one neutral hydroxyl hydrogen in the independently parsed base, no other labelled atoms or stereo blocks. Other grammar or ambiguity declines.
ol_hydrogen.origin: Independent oracle for general P-82 suffix nuclide placement, motivated by independently authored deuterated alcohol test; no panel data/reference-name outcomes used.

acid_hydrogen.scope: One 2H/3H descriptor at carboxylic acid or oic acid suffix; exactly one neutral carbon-bound acid OH in an independently raw-parsed base; unsupported/ambiguous/charged/radical/stereo cases decline.
acid_hydrogen.policy: Name-only input; no original graph, reference name, production naming call or panel-derived evidence.

mixed_esters.scope: P-65.6.3.3.3.2; independently raw-parsed small alkane-diol and two carboxylates; both ester-site assignments must give a single canonical graph; unsupported or ambiguous cases decline.
mixed_esters.policy: Name-only input; no original graph, reference name, production naming call or panel-derived evidence.

peroxolate_salts.scope: One plain binary Li/Na/K carbon-peroxolate; independently raw-parsed neutral peroxol and explicit metal(1+); unique O-OH hydron removal, valence/H/element/charge conservation; unsupported or ambiguous forms decline.
peroxolate_salts.policy: No original graph or NISPO naming code. Corrects raw-parser charge loss only after independent name proof; raw graph and proof graph remain recorded separately.

functional_operations.scope: Unannotated primary hydrocarbylamine dianion; symmetric acyclic saturated carboxylic dianhydride with two identical terminal acids and a dibasic central acid. Independent parsed components, unique sites, hydrogen/element/charge conservation and parser graph ownership. Other grammar declines.
functional_operations.origin: Existing independently authored functional boundaries; baseline frozen at dist/0.2.0rc1-viability-20261117T112204Z/baseline-manifest.json. No panel records selected.
functional_operations.policy: Name-only input, no production naming calls or original graph; only raw OPSIN rejections supplemented. Raw outcomes remain visible.

phospho_hydrogen.scope: One neutral diphosphooxy prefix, unique unbranched P-O-P, three acid oxygen sites and one separately declared onium centre; independently parsed charge/H correction only with exact heavy-atom/H/charge conservation. Other grammar or ambiguity declines.
phospho_hydrogen.origin: Existing pre-release regression; historical molecule provenance retained in initial-triage.json and test-history.json. Independent hand-authored phosphoethylammonium parser controls.
phospho_hydrogen.policy: Name and independent parser graphs only; no original input molecule, production naming calls or reference panel. Raw parser outcomes remain recorded.
